name: High-Performance & Extreme-Environment Materials Chemistry
summary: Chemistry of the fibres, resins, composites, ceramics and coatings used in rockets, armour and extreme environments.

topics.name: High-performance fibres: carbon fibre, aramids (Kevlar), UHMWPE and PBO
High-temperature polymers: polyimides, PEEK, bismaleimides and cyanate esters
Thermoset resins: epoxy chemistry and curing
Fibre-reinforced polymer composites and fibre-matrix interfaces
Ultra-high-temperature ceramics (ZrB2, HfC) and refractory metals
Thermal protection systems and ablative materials
Superalloys and thermal/environmental barrier coatings: oxidation chemistry
Lightweight alloys: titanium, aluminium-lithium and magnesium
Armour and impact-resistant materials: ceramics and laminates
Space-environment durability: atomic oxygen, UV, radiation and vacuum outgassing
Adhesives and sealants for extreme environments
